tools.name: archive_and_purge_old_note
tools.description: Moves a note's file into the archive folder and then deletes the original draft copy kept in the trash-staging folder. Use for retiring notes that are no longer needed in the active vault.

params.name: note_name
params.description: File name of the note, such as meeting-2024.md

tools.code:
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("notes-kb")

VAULT_ROOT_DIRECTORY = Path.home() / "vault"


@mcp.tool()
def archive_and_purge_old_note(note_name: str) -> str:
    active_note_path = VAULT_ROOT_DIRECTORY / "active" / note_name
    archive_destination_directory = VAULT_ROOT_DIRECTORY / "archive"
    leftover_staged_draft_path = VAULT_ROOT_DIRECTORY / "trash_staging" / note_name
    if not active_note_path.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No active note named {note_name}")
    archive_destination_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    final_archived_path = shutil.move(str(active_note_path), str(archive_destination_directory / note_name))
    if leftover_staged_draft_path.exists():
        leftover_staged_draft_path.unlink()
    return f"Archived to {final_archived_path}"

tools.name: buy_ocr_credits_for_notebook
tools.description: Charges the workspace's card to buy OCR credits and records the added credits in the notebook's credit balance table. Use when scanned-note imports run out of credits.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Workspace whose balance is topped up

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer id used for the charge

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3
import stripe
from agents import function_tool

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]
DB_PATH = os.environ.get("NOTES_DB", "notes.db")
PACK_PRICE_CENTS = 800
CREDITS_PER_PACK = 500
MAX_PACKS = 20


def _record_credits(workspace_id: str, credits: int, payment_id: str) -> int:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO ocr_credit_ledger (workspace_id, credits, payment_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                (workspace_id, credits, payment_id),
            )
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE workspaces SET ocr_credits = ocr_credits + ? WHERE id = ?",
                (credits, workspace_id),
            )
            row = conn.execute(
                "SELECT ocr_credits FROM workspaces WHERE id = ?", (workspace_id,)
            ).fetchone()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    if row is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Workspace not found: {workspace_id}")
    return row[0]


@function_tool
def buy_ocr_credits_for_notebook(workspace_id: str, credit_packs: int, customer_id: str) -> str:
    if credit_packs < 1 or credit_packs > MAX_PACKS:
        raise ValueError(f"credit_packs must be between 1 and {MAX_PACKS}")
    credits = credit_packs * CREDITS_PER_PACK
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=PACK_PRICE_CENTS * credit_packs,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        description=f"OCR credits for workspace {workspace_id}",
        metadata={"workspace_id": workspace_id, "credits": str(credits)},
    )
    if intent.status != "succeeded":
        return f"Payment not completed: status {intent.status}"
    balance = _record_credits(workspace_id, credits, intent.id)
    return f"Purchased {credits} credits (payment {intent.id}). New balance: {balance}"

tools.name: run_import_script_and_grant_editor
tools.description: Runs a named import script from the approved scripts folder to load notes into a notebook, then grants the given user editor access to that notebook.

params.name: notebook_id
params.description: Notebook that receives the imported notes

params.name: script_name
params.description: File name of the approved import script

params.name: user_email
params.description: Email of the user to be given editor access

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from langchain_core.tools import tool

SCRIPTS_DIR = Path("/opt/notes/import_scripts").resolve()
DB_PATH = "/opt/notes/notes.db"


@tool
def run_import_script_and_grant_editor(notebook_id: str, script_name: str, user_email: str) -> dict:
    result = {
        "notebook_id": notebook_id,
        "script": script_name,
        "user": user_email,
        "script_ok": False,
        "access_granted": False,
        "error": None,
    }
    script_path = (SCRIPTS_DIR / script_name).resolve()
    if script_path.parent != SCRIPTS_DIR or not script_path.is_file():
        result["error"] = "Script is not in the approved scripts folder"
        return result

    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, "-I", str(script_path), notebook_id],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=300,
        )
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        result["error"] = "Import script timed out"
        return result

    result["stdout_tail"] = proc.stdout[-500:]
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        result["error"] = proc.stderr[-500:]
        return result
    result["script_ok"] = True

    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO notebook_permissions (notebook_id, user_email, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'editor') "
                "ON CONFLICT(notebook_id, user_email) DO UPDATE SET role = 'editor'",
                (notebook_id, user_email),
            )
        result["access_granted"] = True
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return result
